title: Omikave
tagline: A decentralized marketplace for monetizing Omi data, powered by Akave and bootstrapped with FIL-Frame!

prizes.title: Store your hackathon project data using Akave

description:
Big Tech collects billions of conversational data points through ChatGPT, Siri, Alexa, and more. This is often done without transparent user consent, ultimately fueling a $230 billion global data monetization market, where companies profit while individuals are left out. These devices might also be listening to you in the background, creating mistrust + privacy concerns.

Omikave gives users control + money over their data through a decentralized marketplace. It's built on Omi's open source software, and data is secured + encrypted through Akave's storage solution. You can now transparently own, analyze, and sell your own data!

Some use cases include selling conversations for training AI models / AI research, buying anonymized transcripts for consumer trend analysis, and selling transcripts of user research interviews.
how_its_made:
**Akave**: Secure + encrypted upload/download/storage of transcript data
**FIL-Frame**: used the Akave intregration, which sped up upload/download dev work significantly
**Omi**: Webhook for live conversation data
**Blockchain**: smart contract with gating + verifying functions was used to ensure only users who bought the data can download it
